info.description: One row per user who has opted in to the affiliate program. Owns the referralCode and its enable/disable lifecycle. Commission-related fields are intentionally NOT in this schema — they will be added in a later phase once commission rules are finalised.

referralCode.description: URL-safe uppercase alphanumeric slug. Generated via crypto.randomBytes → Crockford's base32. Rotation on regenerate keeps history via the audit log; old code stops resolving immediately.

status.description: active = code resolves + signup attribution live. disabled = code returns 404 at click endpoint + signup attribution ignored. terminated = same as disabled + never re-enable-able (soft-delete).

disabledReason.description: Free-text admin note. Not exposed to the affiliate themselves.

lastCodeRotationAt.description: Rate-limit signal — front-end can throttle the self-service regenerate button.
